title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（相良純一研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sagara Jun-Ichi)
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) skills of biotechnology and/or bioinformatics (chemoinformatics).
(2) concepts of biology, microbiology and enzymology.
(3) to create/write presentation materials and presentation scripts.
(4) concepts of regional revitalization.
advice:
This is a design project course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Biology, microbiology and enzymology and biotechnology
2. Bioinformatics and chemoinformatics (computer science)
3. Development of educational tools (include information literacy)

Students are required to actively participate in seminars.
Students are expected to work together in laboratory sessions.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms.
Students are expected to solve tasks independently.
Students should attend all seminars as the handouts may not be received.
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III.
Sufficient skill in biology, microbiology, enzymology and data science.
Basic computer skills.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and explain the concepts of design project III
Ability to prepare and operate measuring instruments.
Ability to logically explain our research objectives.
Ability to create presentation materials and final report.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a design project course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Biology, microbiology and enzymology and biotechnology
2. Bioinformatics and chemoinformatics (computer science)
3. Development of educational tools (include information literacy)

Students are required to actively participate in seminars.
Students are expected to work together in laboratory sessions.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms.
Students are expected to solve tasks independently.
Students should attend all seminars as the handouts may not be received.
